actions.collecting: Keep the call going; not enough audio yet to score.
actions.low: Smoothed spoof risk is low. Continue, still verify out-of-band for sensitive steps.
actions.uncertain: Risk is inconclusive. Pause the request and use a known callback or MFA.
actions.high: Smoothed risk is high. Pause the request and verify through a known callback number.
actions.unavailable: Audio quality or stream integrity failed. Do not treat this as a real-speech score.
